lines: This is Violet Glass. A skin for Video J-S ten.
Frosted controls float over the picture, then fade away while you watch.
Scrub, and the timeline shows a live preview, with chapter titles.
Speed, quality, and subtitles in three languages, all in one quiet menu.
On desktop, play sits centered beneath the timeline.
On tablets and phones, the controls become glass orbs, right under your thumb.
Go fullscreen on Android, and it turns to landscape.
Every control works from the keyboard. And when you ask for less motion, it calms down.
Streamed by Mux. Built on Video J-S.
